So, in the general settings, you can't change anything. In my case, the maximum bitrate is very low because I have a 4G modem. If you have good internet, I recommend putting here 3600. It's worth noting that the higher the bitrate, the better the quality of the broadcast. If your viewers have a slow internet and you put a very high maximum bitrate, then they simply won't be able to watch your broadcast. We put the gallower on the multi-potent process. If you have a very weak computer, we choose Fast or Faster. If you have a very powerful computer, we choose Superfast. We choose the encoding profile.
